findings.evidence: Actual AST-extracted functions with real Motor/Mongo on a unique retained local database:both same-token consumers accepted under a controlled read barrier;injected token-marker write failure left a changed password and unused token,then accepted retry.
findings.preconditions_and_limits: An existing account and unused/unexpired valid synthetic token;deliberately forced concurrent read or post-password-write failure. No arbitrary unauthenticated takeover or deployed-account exploit is claimed.
findings.minimal_proposed_correction: Atomically claim the active token and update the user in the same existing transaction/session;check matched user count;ensure rollback and safe retry. Keep existing token-expiry/used/hash checks and API behavior. Owner authorization required. RESET-18 missing-user false success and RESET-10 invalid SMTP_PORT cleanup are LOW subissues within this recovery finding,not extra numbered vulnerabilities.

findings.evidence: Actual local Mongo/JWT execution accepted a pre-reset access JWT after a successful password reset.
findings.preconditions_and_limits: Requires possession of a still-valid prior JWT. Current DB user/role lookup,signature/type/expiry and deleted-account checks still apply. The owner must define relevant recovery/logout-all revocation policy.
findings.minimal_proposed_correction: After owner policy approval,introduce a server-side session/password version or equivalent cutoff and verify it during authentication;include reset/logout revocation semantics. Do not change the approved session policy implicitly.

findings.evidence: Source and helper observation select the first X-Forwarded-For value without an in-function trusted-proxy boundary.
findings.preconditions_and_limits: Actual bypass depends on exposed direct ingress or an unsanitized proxy;production proxy trust/sanitization was not examined. Helper observation is not a deployed bypass proof.
findings.minimal_proposed_correction: Obtain authorized ingress evidence;define trusted proxies and use a trustworthy client address at that boundary. No spoofing attack or source correction performed.

findings.evidence: Configured webhook reads full request.body and computes HMAC before event_payload enforces1MiB. The standalone verified_event helper bounds size first,but this endpoint does not call it.

findings.evidence: Actual function body with synthetic in-memory collections and a deterministic count barrier accepts two cross-demotions;remaining_admins=0. Existing own-session demotion rejection passes.
findings.preconditions_and_limits: Two already privileged admins and concurrent cross-demotion are prerequisites. This is model-double execution of an observed source race,not a real Mongo race,customer privilege escalation or production lockout.
findings.minimal_proposed_correction: Serialize admin-role changes through a shared guard/version CAS within the transaction (or equivalent sound serialization),recount and update under that serialization. Merely putting count+updates of different user documents in separate snapshot transactions may allow write skew. Owner authorization and dedicated real-Mongo verification are required.
